name: comment_text
description: The text of a comment on a record.

aiGuidance.purpose: Plain markdown text of one comment, and the comment identity (its label is the start of this text). Humans and agents may write comments. Create the comment as a record, then relate it comments-on (comment to the record it addresses). A comment never edits its target. Authorship is the engine-stamped createdBy (RFC-046); never write an author here.
